##### Project general facts

Park View Residences and Hotel Apartments offering a mixed-use development comprising residential, hospitality, retail, and dining components. This exceptional project offers exciting opportunities to invest in a prestigious success story, with residences ranging from studios to three-bedroom apartments and hotel apartments from studios to two bedrooms. All units are conceived to exacting standards, creating desirable, liveable homes that residents will love.

Health and wellness are a priority with an onsite gym, green spaces, an exclusive residents' garden, and a showstopping infinity pool situated high above ground offering stunning views of the adjacent park and surrounding areas. The adjacent park adds to the feeling of vitality, while onsite retail, cafés, and restaurants create a vibrant community atmosphere. Residents enjoy exclusive access to a state-of-the-art gym and an elevated private garden, ensuring a lifestyle of comfort and well-being.

Each residence features modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating living spaces that exude sophistication and contemporary elegance. The thoughtfully designed interiors maximize comfort and style, while equipped kitchens ensure effortless culinary experiences. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a harmonious and inviting home environment.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated on Saadiyat Island, a thoughtfully curated community that embodies the pursuit of cultural enrichment, luxurious living, and natural beauty. This prestigious destination is designed to harmonize residential, cultural, and recreational elements, creating a vibrant and interconnected community that celebrates the finer aspects of life. The island is home to world-renowned cultural institutions like the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the upcoming Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, making it a hub for artistic expression, education, and inspiration.

Residents have unparalleled access to cultural experiences, fostering a sense of intellectual and creative engagement that elevates the community's character. The island's natural beauty plays a significant role in shaping the community's identity, with pristine beaches, lush parks, and serene waterfront views offering a tranquil escape from the bustling city. The integration of nature into the community design encourages a balanced and healthful way of life.

The location is in the university neighborhood adjacent to a prestigious university campus, with transportation facilities around the corner. All the excitement of the island is on the doorstep, and downtown Abu Dhabi is just moments away. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of cultural richness, natural beauty, and urban accessibility, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Abu Dhabi's most prestigious destinations.
